cohort: 200 pregnant women at term who underwent vaginal swab culture during routine prenatal check-up at a hospital in Lucknow, Uttar Pradesh, India, between July 2019 and January 2020.
finding: Abnormal vaginal microbiota was associated with adverse pregnancy outcomes, including increased maternal complications, LSCS rate, low APGAR scores, need for neonatal resuscitation, and NICU admission.
